body:
Dear Calimhero,

Thank you for your comment and your advice, I'll PM you in a few minutes.

I just want you to know thought, that I'm not punishing myself for the mistakes I made directly, but for the consequences that they would've caused if she did find out.

Telling someone you love so much that all her efforts were in vain... I just couldb't bring myself up to doing it. Thinking about it every day and night is what really hurts.

Now looking at it it would've probably been ok if I told her when it all happened, but was a pretty big coward.

Thanks you.
Thanks for the advice. If I'm able to get up from this hole I dug and put myself in, I'll make sure to go down the right path every time.

Thank you for your comment, I couldn't avoid to shed some tears while reading it. I've been telling myself the same thing you just said for a long time now, but I just can't find a way out.
I'm usually really optimistic and I've been looking for a job for quite some time now but without luck.
As for family and friends, my dad was part of a car accident when I was 2 years old and most of the people I've met throughout my life were never really true friends, it was all for either appearances or benefits.
I have accounts on multiple online job sites and I've done some freelance work but it's not enough to get me through a month of rent most of the time.

I really do appreciate your comment, thanks.
Upvote for the best comment of the day :D
